name: Veronika Vrecionová - Proposition de la Commission
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the welfare of dogs and cats and their traceability
part_text:
The Parliament wants new EU-wide rules on dogs and cats bred, kept or sold in the EU. It backs minimum welfare standards for breeding, selling and shelter places, and a system to trace each animal back to its origin. It also wants tighter rules on imports from outside the EU, a ban on selling dogs and cats in pet shops, limits on inbreeding and mutilation, and better information for buyers, including online.

- Breeders, sellers, shelters and online platforms face registration, approval and welfare duties.
- Buyers get written health and care information; some painful practices are banned.
- This is Parliament's first-reading position; talks with EU governments come next.
